From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Forecast grooming: SKU / Amount / Probability action items

Team —

Quick cleanup ask before EOD Friday so finance can close the commit for this week. I pulled the Q3 commit report and there are ~18 mid-to-large deals with missing or inconsistent fields that will materially affect our commit number. Please prioritize the items below for any opportunities you own or are covering: 

1) Amount: confirm ARR/TCV in HubSpot matches signed pricing (no currency conversion quirks). If numbers differ, add a 1-line note in the opportunity and update the amount field.
2) SKU / Product: map deals to one of our canonical SKUs (RED-API, RED-DEDICATED, RED-PRIVATE). If it's a bundle, pick the dominant SKU and list the rest in the notes.
3) Probability: set to a calibrated % based on stage and recent engagement (see quick guide below). Do not leave default 50% for late-stage deals.
4) Next step & owner: put the next concrete step (e.g., "Legal signoff scheduled 7/7") and assign an owner.
5) Close date sanity check: if the date is >60 days from typical sales cycle for that SKU, either move it out of commit or add context.

I've attached a lightweight CSV template (forecast-cleanup-template.csv) — paste one row per opp and return to me or drop into the shared Drive. I will consolidate responses and send the cleaned commit to Finance Friday morning.

Mini probability guidance (calibration):
- Contract signed/PO received: 95%
- Legal redlines agreed, exec buy-in: 80%
- Demo + procurement engaged, pricing agreed: 60%
- Discovery complete, pricing proposed: 40%

Please reply with "ACK" after you start and put any blockers in-line. Thanks — I know this is a squeeze.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
